note: Rules-enforced Pro deck (server hero kenshiro), mirrored from the-unmatched.club deck 12653 "Kenshiro" by Calton White (https://www.the-unmatched.club/c/heroes/kenshiro.12653), version 2026.07.30 "Initial". A community LAB deck — engine JollyGrin/unbrewed-engine#362 (on the #359/#360 train), so values/mechanics are not final. TUC has no unmatched.cards page, so the deck id is ours and this snapshot is the only source. Card faces are the author's OWN finished renders — his TUC `replacementImage` set, which he hotlinked to i.imgur.com; every one is mirrored into public/evergreen-decks/art/kenshiro (imgur rots; #446 standard) and drawn full-bleed via cardImage, never through the generated card template, which cannot reproduce his banners and layout. URLs are repo-relative (Luke/Malfurion precedent) so the art resolves on localhost and preview builds too. Titles/values/boosts/quantities are the author's verbatim, typos included ("damege", the `kENSHIRO` banner on Hundred-Fist Rush) — art matches by verbatim title, so never "fix" them. cardback.webp is his own `cardsBack`; hero-card.webp is his `customImage` hero render (mirrored, not yet referenced by any UI surface); token-kenshiro.webp is a bust cropped from that cardback art for the board token and seat thumbnail. The three HOKUTO stages printed on Hundred-Fist Rush (WAAAA / TATATA / WAATAAA!) are the sub-attack chain engine#359's followup queue drains — see lib/pro/subAttackChain.ts for the client-side narration.
